deliveryLog.title: Delivery log
deliveryLog.noRecipient: This invoice has no recipient email on file.
deliveryLog.helpText: One entry per time Brygge emailed this invoice and what happened to it. Sends through Amazon SES show the delivery report SES received; older sends come from the club mail server's log, which covers about the last month. "Accepted" means the recipient's server took the mail; whether it then landed in the inbox or in spam cannot be seen from here.
deliveryLog.noSends: Brygge has not emailed this invoice. It may have been sent by the previous system.

statusHelp.deferred: The recipient's server asked to try again later (greylisting, for example). The mail server retries on its own.
statusHelp.rejected: The recipient's server refused the mail. Check the address and resend.
statusHelp.no_record: The mail server has no record of this send, so the mail probably never left it. Resend the invoice, and report it if it happens again.
statusHelp.pending: Sent a few minutes ago; the mail server log may not show it yet.
statusHelp.beyond_retention: The mail server log only covers about the last month.
statusHelp.unavailable: The mail server log cannot be read on this server.
statusHelp.sending: Brygge is handing the mail to the mail service. If this stays for more than a few minutes, the send was interrupted: ask the recipient before resending.
statusHelp.submitted: The mail service has the message; its delivery report usually follows within minutes.
statusHelp.failed: The mail service refused the message before taking it, so nothing was sent. Resend the invoice.
statusHelp.unknown: The connection broke while the message was being handed over, so it may or may not have gone out. Ask the recipient before resending, to avoid a duplicate.
statusHelp.rejected_temporary: The recipient's server kept asking to try later until the mail service gave up. Check the address and resend later.
statusHelp.suppressed: Amazon SES did not send this mail: the address bounced hard earlier (or the recipient reported spam), so it is on the club's suppression list. If the address is right and the bounce will not repeat (a full mailbox that has been emptied, or a fault on the club's side), remove it from the list and resend the invoice.
statusHelp.complaint: The recipient marked the mail as spam. Do not resend, and do not remove the address from the suppression list; contact the member another way.

deliveryLog.hardBounceHint: A hard bounce also puts the address on the suppression list, so later mail to it is blocked. Correct the address if it is wrong; if it was right, remove it from the list before resending.

unsuppress.confirmBody: Amazon SES will send to this address again. Only do this if the address is correct and the bounce will not happen again, never after the recipient marked mail as spam. Then resend the invoice.
unsuppress.done: Removed from the suppression list. Resend the invoice to deliver it.
unsuppress.notListed: The address was not on the suppression list. You can resend the invoice.

parter.title: Parties
parter.body: These terms apply between {club} ("the club", "we", "us"), org.no. {orgNumber}, as seller, and the buyer ("you", "the buyer") who places an order through the club's online services or in person.

betaling.title: Payment
betaling.body: Payment is made via the channels we offer — typically Vipps, card (including Apple Pay and Google Pay), bank transfer with KID, or invoice. The amount due, payment deadline, and KID number are stated on the invoice/order confirmation. Late payment may incur reminder fees and interest in accordance with the Late Payment Interest Act (forsinkelsesrenteloven).

oppsigelse.title: Cancellation and stopping recurring payments
oppsigelse.body: There is no binding period. You can cancel your membership or stop a recurring payment/charge at any time. To cancel, contact {club}{contact}. Recurring Vipps agreements can also be cancelled yourself in the Vipps app under "Agreements". Cancellation takes effect from the next billing period, after which you will not be charged again. Membership fees already paid are normally not refunded.
oppsigelse.contactPageFragment: through the contact page on this website

levering.title: Delivery
levering.body: Digital goods (memberships, berth assignments, guest harbor stays) take effect immediately upon registered payment. Physical merchandise is delivered by post or for pickup at the harbor master's hut as agreed at checkout. Expected delivery time is stated for each product.

angrerett.title: Right of withdrawal
angrerett.body: For digital services that begin immediately at your request (e.g. a guest slip booking for the same day, a confirmed member registration), the right of withdrawal lapses once delivery has started, in accordance with the Norwegian Right of Withdrawal Act (angrerettloven) §22. For physical merchandise you have 14 days from receipt to cancel without giving a reason. Contact the treasurer to use your right of withdrawal.

retur.title: Returns
retur.body: Returned merchandise must be unused and in its original condition. You cover the return shipping unless the goods are defective. Refunds are paid back to the same payment method used for the purchase, normally within 14 days of receipt of the returned goods.

reklamasjon.title: Complaints handling
reklamasjon.body: If something is wrong with the product or service, contact us as soon as possible — and at the latest within reasonable time after the defect was or should have been discovered. The deadline for complaints is two years from receipt, or five years for items intended for significantly longer use. Send complaints to the treasurer or, for harbor-related matters, the harbor master.

konflikt.title: Dispute resolution
konflikt.body: We aim to resolve any disagreement amicably. If we cannot agree, the buyer can bring the matter before the Consumer Council (Forbrukertilsynet) or the Consumer Disputes Commission (Forbrukerklageutvalget). EU consumers can use the European Commission's online dispute resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/odr. Norwegian law applies and Norwegian courts are the venue.
